title: TractionCurrentPersistenceDecisionRuleAndApproval
description: Formal metrological decision rule, mathematical criteria, and multi-disciplinary engineering approvals establishing the approved persistence window for electrical traction de-energization.

decision_rule_structure.mathematical_formula: I_motor_RMS(t) < 0.500 A RMS continuously for delta_t >= T_persist (subject to RMS-PROC-V1.0)
decision_rule_structure.guarded_mathematical_formula: I_motor_RMS(t) <= (0.500 A - 0.087 A) = 0.413 A RMS continuously for delta_t >= 10.0 ms within total latency <= 48.8 ms

PERSISTENCE_PASS.definition: Phase U line current drops and remains continuously <= 0.413 A RMS for delta_t >= 10.0 ms without single-sample excursion, achieving electrical traction de-energization within guarded total latency <= 48.8 ms.

PERSISTENCE_FAIL.definition: Phase U line current fails to drop below 0.500 A RMS within 48.8 ms of E-Stop command, OR drops below threshold but rebounds above 0.500 A RMS before the 10.0 ms persistence window elapses.

PERSISTENCE_UNDETERMINED.definition: Oscilloscope record truncated before 10.0 ms persistence window can be evaluated, OR signal-to-noise ratio SNR < 10 dB, OR current probe amplifier saturation flag active.

formal_signoff_and_approval_record.engineering_rationale: Comprehensive bench testing on AGV-RES-TRUCK-01 demonstrated that a 10.0 ms persistence window at 0.5 A RMS (guarded 0.413 A) provides 100% rejection of 10 kHz PWM ripple and AC zero crossings, while ensuring a mean cutoff latency of 33.4 ms with a 13.0 ms safety margin to the 48.8 ms guarded threshold.
